These fixtures contain only the factual report-board excerpts used by the parsers, retrieved on 2026-10-18 in Japan. Missing off-season snow values remain missing. Tests modify copies to exercise winter values and invalid responses; those generated values are not resort observations.

- `rusutsu-snow.html`: the first `.weather-wrap` from https://rusutsu.com/en/snow-and-weather-report/ . The source prints a day/month/year timestamp and identifies West Mt. The 24-hour snowfall field is separate from accumulated snow depth.
- `rusutsu-lifts.json`: only `other` and `lift` from https://rusutsu.com/assets/partial/ajax/trail-and-lift/get-front.php . The resort's public https://rusutsu.com/assets/js/front/lift-and-trail-status/index.js uses `other.update` as a Unix timestamp. Its `index.partial/output-lift.js` maps explicit Japanese operating states to localized labels. This captured update is from April 2, 2026 JST; fetching it in October does not make it current.
- `madarao-snow.html`: `.bar-condition-inner` from https://www.madarao.jp/ski . The source names `降雪（24H）` explicitly and prints its report date and AM/PM time. No station height is supplied. Its lift table says `リフト運行予定` (schedule), so the adapter does not use it as a current operating report.

Additional factual excerpts retrieved on **2026-10-21 in Japan**:

- `happo-snow.html`: only the Kurobishi `.condition-data` board, with its surrounding `.condition-container`, from https://www.happo-one.jp/en/winter/ . It identifies Kurobishi at 1,680 m and prints `Update at 2026.10.21 07:35`. The reported depth is explicitly zero, not a placeholder. `SnowFall` is also zero but has no explicit 24-hour observation window, so the adapter never maps it to `snowfall24hCm`. The other stations have different timestamps and are not substituted. The official webcam page is https://www.happo-one.jp/en/gelande/livecamera/ .
- `nozawa-lifts.html`: only the visible factual table rows and heading from `#now_lift` on https://en.nozawaski.com/the-mountain/moutain-info/slopes-lifts/ . Its separate full-year lift update is **06/May/2026 15:54**, not the October retrieval date or another section's date. The 17 listed entries include Yu road. Opening hours are schedules and never determine state. Only explicit `◯`, `△`, `×` symbols are normalized, according to the official legend at https://nozawaski.com/winter/lift_price/lift_time/ (`◯` operating, `△` awaiting weather/inspection, `×` closed). Unknown symbols stay unknown. The production HTML's commented retired lift rows are excluded; tests add a commented row to check this behavior.

Nozawa's separate snow report board gives month/day and time without a year, and its fresh-snow period is yesterday 15:00–today 08:00. Neither an inferred year nor a 24-hour total is manufactured from those fields. Akakura Kanko's official https://akr-ski.com/ and https://akr-ski.com/slope/ pages did not expose a dated snow board on the verification date; undated lift states and future operating schedules were not captured as current observations. These gaps require a later verified source change, not invented readings.
